header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None is present on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation is
received. This petition was filed in the year 2023 and lastly fixed on
23.08.2023, when at the request of learned counsel for the petitioner the matter
body: was adjourned. Since then, no efforts have been made by the counsel for the petitioner to get the matter fixed before the Court or to proceed with it. Today position remains same. It appears that counsel for the petitioner has lost interest to pursue with the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
